all ADR files are indexed
local markdown links resolve

manifest bytes/hashes match checkpoint contents

every requirement is traced to existing gates/release gates or an allowed obligation kind
threat register references only existing requirements/gates and names at least one mitigation doc that exists
later-wave scopes never appear in depends_on of earlier-wave scopes
no current document claims post-quantum confidentiality for v1 groups

every gate declares interface_impact and feasibility_status

every document basename is unique so docs resolve independent of folder layout

every interface-impact gate declares feasibility_criteria and feasibility_status evidenced requires every feasibility criterion met (ADR-0134)
verification prototypes used before scope authorization are non-production evidence only; implementation-dependent evidence belongs to pre-release (ADR-0134)
verification review-only dependencies are batched after repo-local evidence rather than forming an agent-to-agent execution loop (ADR-0134)

every named security invariant in SECURITY_INVARIANTS.md has exactly one machine/security_invariant_traceability.json entry whose referenced requirements/threats/decisions/evidence/sources exist; this mapping never marks a gate passed (ADR-0139)

for frozen W0 wire objects, canonical CDDL plus frozen registries/domain-separation rules are authoritative over logical modeling schemas; logical schemas cannot add wire fields or semantics (ADR-0139)

OMA-ENC-1-candidate is verification-only and cannot become a production portability encryption profile without V-014 freeze/review (ADR-0139)
final design closure keeps engineering_authorized false until named scopes independently satisfy the existing unlock contract; design_open=0 is not engineering authorization (ADR-0139)
AsyncKeyBundle v1 omits retired ACS keys 3/4; prekey generation is globally monotonic per device/profile across provider pools and one-time prekeys are context-bound (ADR-0140)

LegacyPolicy criticality, bearer-capability transport hygiene, RecoveryRecord freshness/advisory semantics, frozen W0 domain-label status, resolved group-call participant-only media-key semantics and the 300-second default time skew are machine-checked semantic invariants (ADR-0141)
